def arithmetic_series_multiple_of_d_up_to_upper_bound(d: int, upper_bound) -> int:
    """
    Sum of natural numbers up to upper_bound multiples of d.

    - O(1) time-complexity
    - O(1) space-complexity
    """
    n = (upper_bound - 1) // d
    S = d * n * (n + 1) // 2
    return S
